summary: Frontend UI testing for Iteration 4 (Empty initial data + Editable Brand + 'Rekap' header title + '0'/'Sari Ekawati' placeholders). All 23 automated checks PASSED via Playwright on mobile viewport (390x844). Verified: (1) App loads with empty state 'Belum ada data titipan' when no data. (2) Header shows 'Rekap' (not 'Rekap Titipan'). (3) Default brand 'Bintang Snack' rendered in italic serif with pencil icon at brand-edit-btn. (4) Header stats strip shows Rp 0 / Titip 0 / Sisa 0 in empty state. (5) Brand edit modal opens on tap; input+cancel+save controls present; Simpan updates brand to 'Toko Kue Sari' with toast; brand persists across reload via AsyncStorage BRAND_KEY. (6) Add Penitip modal: Nama Penitip placeholder='Sari Ekawati'; Harga Pokok/Jual/Titip/Sisa all placeholder='0' with empty initial value (placeholder visible). (7) Form save creates card, TOTAL SETOR shows Rp 6.000, TITIP 5, SISA 2. (8) Data persists after reload via STORAGE_KEY v3. (9) Recap Setoran tab shows the consignor card with correct values. (10) Delete flow via confirm modal returns to empty state. No React Native red screens, no console errors (only benign expo-web shadow*/boxShadow deprecation warnings from library CSS). Web preview cannot exercise camera / expo-sharing but code paths were not triggered, no crash observed.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is ~1700+ lines — consider splitting RecapShotCard, modals, and styles into separate modules for maintainability (non-blocking).

Console warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' originates from shadow* usage in StyleSheet (e.g., groupCard). Consider migrating to boxShadow for React Native Web parity (cosmetic, non-blocking on native).
seed_data_creation: None — INITIAL_CONSIGNMENT_GROUPS is now [] as per requirement. Test creates ephemeral 'Sari Ekawati' record and then deletes it.
